author_published_farm_classification.citation: Ranke et al 2021 Journal of Animal Ecology doi:10.1111/1365-2656.13580 Study populations and Fig 1

nested_predictive_models.P0: Destination-year-agnostic attractiveness from historical incoming natal migrant counts plus one Laplace pseudocount, exclude self
nested_predictive_models.H: P0(j|i) * exp(beta * indicator[same farm class origin_i and recipient_j]), re-normalize for every origin i; beta trained ONLY historical 259 records by maximizing training multinomial loglik minus beta²/2
nested_predictive_models.beta_grid: ALL fixed 801 values from -4.00 through +4.00 step 0.01, deterministic ties prefer smaller absolute magnitude then smaller signed beta; no future outcome tuning
nested_predictive_models.R2: Historical UNDIRECTED pair U_ij=historic i→j + historic j→i smoothed toward H by tau prior pseudocounts
nested_predictive_models.C2: Historical DIRECTIONAL pair i→j smoothed toward R2 by tau prior pseudocounts
nested_predictive_models.primary: R2-H future 173 observed migrant destination mean negative logloss at tau=10; negative means exact pair information survives broad habitat-class + receiving popularity baseline
nested_predictive_models.secondary: H-P0: published farm/non-farm main status predictive in future resight observations; C2-R2: directionality beyond undirected after habitat reference
nested_predictive_models.sensitivities: tau=5,10,20 all frozen before this new scoring and all reported
nested_predictive_models.robustness: all origins with at least one later recorded migrant, every leave-one-origin-out primary, all 11 original source islands, no posthoc subgroup exclusions

do_not_claim: Unique geography/distance-independent pair mechanism: inter-island distance is NOT explicitly measured or adjusted
Observed source extinction, population rescue, true colonization, observed immigrant reproductive fitness or synchronous recipient collapse
Independent archipelago replication or preregistered prospective result: both authors and previous Structural scripts exposed outcomes
If primary R2-H weak/adverse, no new-structure claim and no subgroup/tau rescue
